title: oomol-lab/open-connector
claim: oomol-lab/open-connector — Open-source auth gateway connecting 1000+ SaaS providers to AI agents through SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP, and OpenAPI.
why_good: An open auth + integration gateway wiring 1000+ SaaS providers to agents via SDK/CLI/MCP/HTTP/OpenAPI — the unglamorous plumbing every agent product otherwise rebuilds. Effectively 'Merge / Zapier for agents'.
value: Integration & auth gateways monetize hard (see Merge.dev, Nango): usage-based + managed connectors + enterprise SSO — and agents make this layer bigger, not smaller.
risk: Crowded (Nango, Composio, Merge) and the MCP standard itself could absorb it; winning needs breadth, reliability and enterprise trust.

zh.claim: oomol-lab/open-connector —— 开源鉴权网关,通过 SDK / CLI / MCP / HTTP / OpenAPI 把 1000+ 家 SaaS 接入 AI agent。
zh.why_good: 把 1000+ 家 SaaS 通过 SDK/CLI/MCP/HTTP/OpenAPI 接给 agent 的开源鉴权+集成网关——每个 agent 产品原本都要重造的脏活累活。
zh.value: 集成与鉴权网关很能变现(参考 Merge.dev、Nango):按量 + 托管连接器 + 企业 SSO——而 agent 让这一层更值钱。
zh.risk: 很挤(Nango、Composio、Merge),而且 MCP 标准本身可能吸收它;要赢得靠广度、可靠性与企业信任。
zh.hook: 做 agent 的人被逐个服务的 OAuth 管线淹死;OOMOL 开源了带 1000+ SaaS 连接器的网关——但买单的是开发团队,不是个人。
zh.does: 开源鉴权网关:通过 SDK、CLI、MCP、HTTP、OpenAPI 把 1000+ SaaS 暴露给 AI agent;可部署到 Cloudflare,Apache-2.0。
zh.gap: Composio 一类目录走向收费/封闭,开放目录确实缺——但这是彻头彻尾的 B2B 基建。
zh.counter: 公司项目、目录要工业级维护,Anthropic/OpenAI 官方连接器目录随时碾平;纯开发者/B2B 工具是被排除的切入口;issue 区全是团队 PR,零用户原声。
zh.differentiator: 个人开发者没有入口——留档,作为「agent 接 SaaS 的鉴权正在被商品化」的能力信号。
zh.consumer_angle: 没有——消费者永远看不到鉴权网关。

hook: Agent builders drown in per-service OAuth plumbing; OOMOL ships an open gateway with 1000+ SaaS connectors — but the buyer is a dev team, not a person.
pick_reason: The project provides a valuable integration solution for AI agents, addressing a clear market need with potential for monetization.
does: Open-source auth gateway exposing 1000+ SaaS providers to AI agents via SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP and OpenAPI; Cloudflare-deployable, Apache-2.0.
gap: Composio-style connector catalogs went paid/closed — an open one is genuinely missing. But it is B2B infrastructure end to end.
counter: Company-backed, needs industrial-scale catalog maintenance, and Anthropic/OpenAI first-party connector directories can flatten it. Pure dev/B2B tooling is an excluded wedge; the tracker is all team PRs, zero user voices.
differentiator: None open to a solo founder — archive as a capability signal: agent-to-SaaS auth is being commoditized.
consumer_angle: None — a consumer never sees an auth gateway.
